office_name: County Judge + Sheriff + County Clerk + District Clerk + Tax Assessor-Collector + County Treasurer
notes: Six countywide elected offices share the Hidalgo County boundary: County Judge Richard F. Cortez; Sheriff J.E. Eddie Guerra; County Clerk Arturo Guajardo Jr.; District Clerk Laura Hinojosa; Tax Assessor-Collector Pablo Paul Villarreal Jr.; and County Treasurer Lita Leo. The County Judge also serves as Chairman of Hidalgo County Drainage District No. 1, but that concurrent board assignment is not an additional elected office or geometry. Census GEOID 48215.

David L. Fuentes is the current elected Precinct 1 Commissioner. The reviewed county-associated operational layer uses DISTRICT 1, and the 2021 redistricting resolution controls the current plan. His concurrent Drainage District board service is not an additional elected office or geometry.
